as_written_in_papers.quote: Sanger sequencing identified the patient was heterozygous for c.560T>C p.(Leu187Pro) and c.809C>T p.(Thr270lle) variants of uncertain clinical significance in the LCAT gene.
However, preliminary health screening found she carried the same LCAT variant (c.560T>C) as her brother, negating her ability to be a donor.

cases.statement: Two people in one family carry the variant: the affected male index patient (heterozygous for c.560T>C and for c.809C>T p.(Thr270lle); phase not reported) and his unaffected sister, who carries c.560T>C (her zygosity and her status for c.809C>T are not reported).

people.label: patient
people.zygosity_or_genotype: heterozygous for c.560T>C and heterozygous for c.809C>T (two different variants; phase not reported)
people.key_phenotypes: LCAT deficiency diagnosed in late teens; no CER or LCAT activity; proteinuria from 2004; renal biopsy with histological features of LCAT deficiency; progression to CKD stage 5 and hemodialysis

quotes.quote: Our patient is a 44-year-old Caucasian male diagnosed with LCAT deficiency in his late teens.
These showed no CER or LCAT activity, confirming FLD phenotype.
Proteinuria developed from 2004, and renal biopsy confirmed histological features of LCAT deficiency (Supplementary Figure S1).
We report a patient with FLD whose renal dysfunction progressed to chronic kidney disease stage 5.
Currently, he is listed for deceased donor kidney transplantation, and he commenced hemodialysis in the interim.

people.label: unaffected sister of the patient
people.zygosity_or_genotype: carries c.560T>C; zygosity not stated; status for c.809C>T not reported
people.key_phenotypes: unaffected: no stigmata of FLD, normal renal function, no proteinuria

quotes.quote: His unaffected sister came forward as a potential live donor.
She had no stigmata of FLD, normal renal function, and no proteinuria.
However, preliminary health screening found she carried the same LCAT variant (c.560T>C) as her brother, negating her ability to be a donor.

phenotype_specificity.statement: The index patient had absent CER and LCAT activity, which the authors state confirms the FLD phenotype, and renal biopsy features of LCAT deficiency. No testing of other genes or exclusion of other causes is reported.

quotes.quote: These showed no CER or LCAT activity, confirming FLD phenotype.
Proteinuria developed from 2004, and renal biopsy confirmed histological features of LCAT deficiency (Supplementary Figure S1).

segregation.statement: One affected sister (genotype not reported) and one unaffected sister who carries c.560T>C (her c.809C>T status and zygosity not reported). Parents not reported.

quotes.quote: The patient has 2 sisters: one with LCAT deficiency, the other asymptomatic.
However, preliminary health screening found she carried the same LCAT variant (c.560T>C) as her brother, negating her ability to be a donor.

in_trans.statement: The other variant is c.809C>T p.(Thr270lle) [sic]. Phase was not shown: no parental testing is reported, and the paper says only that the patient was heterozygous for both.

quotes.quote: Sanger sequencing identified the patient was heterozygous for c.560T>C p.(Leu187Pro) and c.809C>T p.(Thr270lle) variants of uncertain clinical significance in the LCAT gene.

functional.statement: No assay of the variant itself. Patient plasma (in-house assays) showed no CER and no LCAT activity; this reflects the patient's combined genotype, not c.560T>C alone. No values or controls are given in the text.

quotes.quote: Cholesterol esterification rate (CER) and LCAT activity were tested by previously described in-house assays.
These showed no CER or LCAT activity, confirming FLD phenotype.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Missense (c.560T>C, predicted p.(Leu187Pro)). The paper describes the disease as impaired cholesterol esterification; no variant-specific mechanism is stated.

quotes.quote: Familial lecithin-cholesterol acyltransferase (LCAT) deficiency (FLD) is a rare disorder of lipid metabolism causing decreased maturation of high density lipoprotein particles and impaired cholesterol esterification.

authors_classification.statement: The authors call both of the patient's variants variants of uncertain clinical significance.

quotes.quote: Sanger sequencing identified the patient was heterozygous for c.560T>C p.(Leu187Pro) and c.809C>T p.(Thr270lle) variants of uncertain clinical significance in the LCAT gene.

concerns: Phase of c.560T>C and c.809C>T is not shown (no parental testing reported); the paper says only 'heterozygous for' both.
The unaffected sister carries c.560T>C; her status for c.809C>T is not reported, and the affected sister's genotype is not reported, so segregation is incomplete.
No transcript is stated in the paper.
The paper writes the second variant as 'p.(Thr270lle)' (letters 'll' rather than 'Il'); quotes keep this as written.
Single case report focused on plasma exchange therapy; genetic details are brief. The extraction labels the sister 'sister of patient 2'; this is an extraction label, not the paper's.
notes_for_panel: Only one paper. The authors' own classification is under authors_classification. Biochemical evidence (absent CER and LCAT activity in patient plasma) applies to the compound genotype.
